title: Location filter defaults to the user's currently active location only
permissions_required: Reports/Performance access; user with access to at least two locations.
preconditions: 1. Your browser has no remembered settings for this report.
2. You are working in a known active location (the application's location switcher).
steps: 1. Open the report and read the location filter's selection.
expected: 1. The filter defaults to the currently active location only — the default view is scoped to the one location you are working in.
